title: Chat list
summary: Shows the chats of the current account, newest activity first, from the SDK room list service. One screen with two scopes: Conversas (DMs and the Pedidos row) and Grupos (rooms with more than two members), ADR 0053.

roomId.description: The Matrix room ID. Stable key for the row.

name.description: The display name the SDK computes for the room.

avatarUrl.description: mxc URL of the room or DM avatar.

lastMessage.description: Plain-text preview of the latest event, as the SDK formats it.

isOfficial.description: A DM whose other person's full user ID is in registries/official-accounts.json: the row shows the Bipe badge after the name (bipe_badge_official, label bipe_badge_official_a11y). Never from a name or a handle.

phase.description: loading: the first sync has not listed the rooms yet. empty: the account has no chats. loaded: chats is not empty.

chats.description: The chats, in the order the room list service gives (newest activity first).

scope.description: conversas: rooms with two members, plus the Pedidos row at the top. grupos: rooms with more than two members.

loadMore.effect: Asks the room list service for the next page when the list scrolls near its end.

notes: MZ decision 25 Oct 2026 (bipe#577): no current-account avatar in the top bar. Você shows the current account (spec voce). This replaces the top-bar avatar of ADR 0135 point 5 for Bipe Next.

Row date (MZ decision 25 Oct 2026, bipe#592): every row with a known event shows its date. The SDK latest event (Room.latestEvent) skips encrypted events that this phone cannot decrypt (matrix-sdk latest_events: m.room.encrypted is never a candidate), so a room whose recent events are all undecryptable has no latest event. The time of an event is not encrypted: such a row takes origin_server_ts of the newest message-like event of the room's local timeline (Room.timeline, the first Timeline.addListener update, no pagination, no network), undecryptable events included; else the newest local event of any kind. Bipe logic: BipeRowActivity (BipeKit, libraries/bipe). Read it again when the room changes in the room list. Rows with no local event stay without a date until the SDK has one.

Keep a known latest-activity timestamp visible while the SDK briefly has no latest-event preview (bipe#590), scoped to this account session. The date label must have room beside a long chat title. Do not invent today's date for an unknown event or wait for network to draw the list. Truly unknown times remain unknown until local SDK data arrives.
bipe_app_chat_list_unread is the accessibility label of the badge. The count comes in already formatted.

A chat with an unread mention (RoomInfo.numUnreadMentions > 0) shows an @ mark before the count, so a mention differs by shape, not only by colour (bipe#497). The badge's accessibility label adds bipe_a11y_mention.
Message requests, filters, search, invites and Bipe trust badges are later issues. The slice lists joined rooms only.

Official accounts (ADR 0117, bipe-chat/bipe#384): the Bipe badge is a small capsule with the text bipe_badge_official in the verified colours, read as bipe_badge_official_a11y. It shows only for a DM whose other person (the hero user ID) is exactly a user ID in registries/official-accounts.json (BipeRegistries.officialAccountIDs / officialAccountIds). A display name, a handle or a lookalike user ID on another server never shows it. A group never shows it. The same rule holds in the chat header (chat-timeline) and person-profile. Bipe logic: BipeOfficialAccounts.isOfficial (BipeKit, libraries/bipe).

DM avatars show photos from the SDK, with initials when absent. A company avatar is a rounded square based on GET /v1/accounts/{userId}/type (ADR 0132), regardless of verification. Group avatars stay distinct room avatars.

The SDK room-list order is authoritative: it incorporates the server recency stamp even while an event preview is missing. Never re-sort all rows by optional locally cached latest-event timestamps. Preserve filtered-list order as well; append out-of-page archived rooms deterministically.

Request SDK latest-event hydration for displayed and loaded-page rooms with RoomListService.subscribeToRooms. In SDK26.08.11 this REPLACES existing subscriptions, so one coordinator per immutable account session must combine owners from all active lists, including Unread, groups, requests and search. Releasing one owner must preserve other lists. Close on sign-out. Publish cached rows before background hydration; no network or decryption gate on opening the app.

A group uses RoomInfo.displayName, including explicit room names, before hero/profile/localpart fallbacks. An absent hero never overrides an available SDK name with Unnamed chat. Do not read another client database or infer a missing date from current time.

A DM (RoomInfo.isDm, ADR 0141) always shows the other person: the name is the hero display name, then RoomInfo.displayName only when it is not the room's own m.room.name (RoomInfo.rawName), then the localpart of the hero user id, then bipe_dm_no_name. The photo is the hero avatar only, never RoomInfo.avatarUrl (m.room.avatar): without one the row shows initials. The same rule holds in search, the share picker, the timeline header, person-profile and notifications.

MZ supplied screenshots of build32 and the previous app on 23 October 2026: list dates/previews are missing on several rows, room ordering differs and a named chat appears unnamed. These are conversation-list parity reports (bipe#590), distinct from individual message clock footers. Use synthetic fixtures in committed regression tests; never publish personal screenshot contents.
Brand marks (ADR 0162, spec brand-mark): a DM row with a reseller shows the first verified mark's line under the name, short and on one line, with bipe_brand_mark_more for the others.
